p: Real-time charge accruals recognize charges as income immediately when a charge transaction is posted, instead of waiting for the end-of-day job. This applies to Working Capital Loans and Progressive Loans.
Two configurations control when charge accrual entries are created.

tr.td: Real-Time: creates the charge accrual entry when the applicable charge transaction is posted. EOD: creates the charge accrual entry through the end-of-day process based on the configured charge-accrual-date.

Real-Time: creates the charge accrual entry when the applicable charge transaction is posted. EOD: creates the charge accrual entry through the end-of-day process based on the configured charge-accrual-date.

ul.li: An accrual transaction with the charge amount is created immediately when a new charge (fee or penalty) is added.
Multiple charges create multiple accrual transactions.
Working Capital Loans natively support multiple accrual transactions per day.
The selected configuration is consistently applied to all applicable charge accrual transactions.
